proposal.description: The per-strike escalation is left out: every cool-down uses base_clks whatever the strike level
proposal.reason: On a second or later hiccup before a clean run clears the strikes (strike_level 2 or more), hiccup_done goes high after base_clks clocks instead of base_clks<<strike_level, so the retry comes early. Even the first hiccup (strike_level 1 once the counter increments) ends after half its intended length.

why: make lint already catches it: make lint: UNUSEDSIGNAL

proposal.description: The escalation is capped one strike early: the shift saturates at MAX_STRIKES_DEFAULT-2 instead of following strike_level up to the level the timer was sized for
proposal.reason: At strike_level 2 or more (a second hiccup before a clean run), hiccup_done goes high after base_clks<<1 clocks instead of base_clks<<strike_level, so the later cool-downs stop growing. Levels 0 and 1 are unchanged.

proposal.description: The interval-reached test wins over the leave-S_HICCUP clear, so a cool-down that finished is not re-armed when the supervisor leaves S_HICCUP
proposal.reason: After a completed cool-down, hiccup_done stays high in S_SS and S_RUN while strike_level is unchanged. The next entry into S_HICCUP then sees the stale flag and exits at once without any cool-down.
